description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests to add, edit, or delete local user configurations for file sharing on a device. It processes JSON input, interacts with a device configuration backend via functions like setStr, addTblObj, and delTblObj, and outputs the original JSON configuration.

methods.name: none (script-level)
methods.description: Main procedural code that processes the AJAX request, decodes JSON, determines action (Add, Edit, Delete), and performs configuration changes accordingly.
